extensions.name: GL_AMD_performance_monitor
extensions.gate: Metal GPU counters; availability depends on device and counter set

extensions.name: GL_ARB_bindless_texture
extensions.reason: Argument buffers; A11 is argument-buffer Tier 1, so limits are lower than desktop GL.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_cull_distance
extensions.reason: MSL exposes clip_distance but not cull_distance; map to clip as an approximation.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_derivative_control
extensions.reason: MSL exposes dfdx/dfdy/fwidth but no fine/coarse derivative control.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_framebuffer_object
extensions.reason: Core FBO path; renderbuffer storage still needs implementation.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_geometry_shader4
extensions.reason: Metal has no geometry stage; compute fallback on A11 and mesh path on Apple7+.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_gpu_shader_fp64
extensions.reason: Apple GPUs and MSL have no fp64; a software double emulation would not satisfy GLSL fp64 semantics.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_gpu_shader_int64
extensions.reason: MSL long/ulong and 64-bit integer uniform support.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_imaging
extensions.reason: Legacy fixed-function imaging subset removed from the core profile; not applicable.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_provoking_vertex
extensions.reason: Reorder indices/expand strips to match the requested provoking-vertex convention.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_query_buffer_object
extensions.reason: Copy query results into buffer storage.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_robust_buffer_access_behavior
extensions.reason: Cannot guarantee robust behavior for arbitrary translated shaders without full bounds instrumentation.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_robustness_isolation
extensions.reason: No process/context isolation primitive in Metal.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_shader_clock
extensions.reason: No per-invocation shader clock; only coarse GPU timestamps are available.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_shader_subroutine
extensions.reason: Translate subroutine uniforms to a switch in MSL.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_sparse_buffer
extensions.reason: Full buffer allocation; page commitment is a no-op.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_sparse_texture
extensions.reason: Allocate full storage; page commitment is a no-op and queries report committed.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_spirv_extensions
extensions.reason: SPIR-V input via SPIRV-Cross; requires vendored dependency.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_tessellation_shader
extensions.reason: Metal tessellation pipeline (tess factor buffer + post-tessellation vertex function).

extensions.name: GL_ARB_texture_border_clamp
extensions.reason: Metal sampler border color is limited; arbitrary border color needs shader emulation.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_texture_compression_bptc
extensions.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

extensions.name: GL_ARB_texture_compression_rgtc
extensions.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

extensions.name: GL_ARB_texture_filter_minmax
extensions.reason: Metal samplers lack min/max filtering; emulate with shader taps.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_texture_storage
extensions.reason: Immutable texture storage is already mapped to Metal textures.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_transform_feedback2
extensions.reason: No native transform-feedback stage; capture via shader writes/second pass.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_transform_feedback3
extensions.reason: No native transform-feedback stage; capture via shader writes/second pass.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_transform_feedback_instanced
extensions.reason: No native transform-feedback stage; capture via shader writes/second pass.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_transform_feedback_overflow_query
extensions.reason: Overflow flag on the emulated XFB capture.

extensions.name: GL_ARB_vertex_attrib_64bit
extensions.reason: No fp64 vertex pipeline; downconvert attributes to float.

extensions.name: GL_EXT_EGL_image_storage
extensions.reason: No EGL images on the Metal backend.

extensions.name: GL_EXT_direct_state_access
extensions.reason: Core-object DSA subset is implementable; legacy client/matrix state is not valid in core.

extensions.name: GL_EXT_multiview_timer_query
extensions.reason: Multi-pass layered rendering with per-view timer queries.

extensions.name: GL_EXT_raster_multisample
extensions.reason: No separate raster/color sample counts; approximate with MSAA.

extensions.name: GL_EXT_shader_framebuffer_fetch_non_coherent
extensions.reason: MSL framebuffer fetch plus a barrier.

extensions.name: GL_EXT_texture_compression_s3tc
extensions.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

extensions.name: GL_EXT_texture_filter_minmax
extensions.reason: Metal samplers lack min/max filtering; emulate with shader taps.

extensions.name: GL_EXT_window_rectangles
extensions.reason: Scissor/discard emulation over the supported window rectangles.

extensions.name: GL_INTEL_conservative_rasterization
extensions.reason: No conservative raster hardware; compute expansion is not spec-exact.

extensions.name: GL_INTEL_performance_query
extensions.gate: Metal GPU counters; availability depends on device and counter set

extensions.name: GL_MESA_framebuffer_swap_xy
extensions.reason: Swap X/Y in the vertex/output path.

extensions.name: GL_NV_command_list
extensions.reason: Vendor command-list token stream has no Metal equivalent; not worth a CPU interpreter.

extensions.name: GL_NV_conservative_raster
extensions.reason: No conservative raster hardware; compute expansion is not spec-exact.

extensions.name: GL_NV_draw_vulkan_image
extensions.reason: Metal has no Vulkan image interop.

extensions.name: GL_NV_framebuffer_mixed_samples
extensions.reason: Metal render passes require a single sample count; resolve/expand as needed.

extensions.name: GL_NV_framebuffer_multisample_coverage
extensions.reason: No separate coverage-sample count; approximate with MSAA.

extensions.name: GL_NV_memory_object_sparse
extensions.reason: No external sparse memory objects; ARB_sparse_* is emulated by full allocation.

extensions.name: GL_NV_path_rendering
extensions.reason: No path-rendering hardware; a CPU path rasterizer is outside the scope of this layer.

extensions.name: GL_NV_shader_atomic_float64
extensions.reason: Requires fp64 atomics; MSL/Apple GPUs do not expose fp64.

extensions.name: GL_NV_shader_atomic_fp16_vector
extensions.reason: MSL has no half-vector atomics; emulate with CAS.

extensions.name: GL_NV_shader_subgroup_partitioned
extensions.reason: MSL SIMD-group operations cover most of this; partitioned ballots need emulation.

extensions.name: GL_NV_texture_rectangle_compressed
extensions.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

extensions.name: GL_NV_vertex_attrib_integer_64bit
extensions.reason: No 64-bit integer vertex fetch; downconvert or split.

extensions.name: GL_OVR_multiview
extensions.reason: Multi-pass layered rendering; no native multiview draw.

extensions.name: GL_OVR_multiview2
extensions.reason: Multi-pass layered rendering; no native multiview draw.
